FILTERFORM.ONLOAD: select @@datod as datod , @@datdo as datdo ,(select naziv from partneri where partneriid = convert(integer,(select VarSet from PubVars where VarIme = 'NasId'))) as tkosmomi,getdate() as datdanas
FILTERFORM.ONLOAD2: if exists( select * from kntknjigaura k inner join kntvrsteknjigaura v on k.kntvrsteknjigauraid=v.kntvrsteknjigauraid where k.datumzakljucka=str(year((dateadd(month,datediff(month,0,getdate())-1,0))),4)+'0101' and v.PDV='I') or right(convert(varchar,(dateadd(month,datediff(month,0,getdate())-1,0)),112),4)>'0430' begin select 'invisible' as PDVK,(dateadd(month,datediff(month,0,getdate())-1,0))as datod,(dateadd(d,-1,left(convert(varchar,getdate(),112),6)+'01')) AS datdo end else begin select 'visible' as PDVK,((dateadd(month,datediff(month,0,getdate())-1,0)))as datod,(dateadd(d,-1,left(convert(varchar,getdate(),112),6)+'01')) AS datdo end
FILTERFORM.CAPTION: Parametri

INPUT.CAPTION: Datum od:
INPUT.NAME: datod
INPUT.ONVALUECHANGED: if exists( select * from kntknjigaura k inner join kntvrsteknjigaura v on k.kntvrsteknjigauraid=v.kntvrsteknjigauraid where k.datumzakljucka=str(year(@@datod),4)+'0101' and v.PDV='I') or right(@@datod,4)>'0430' begin select 'invisible' as PDVK end else begin select 'visible' as PDVK end

INPUT.NAME: PDVK
INPUT.CAPTION: Proknjiži u PDV-K knjiži plaćene račune u tekućoj godini u razdoblje PDV-K prošle godine.
